description: This is an abstract base class defining the interface for secret management implementations, including methods for reading, writing, deleting, and rotating secrets asynchronously and synchronously.

classes.name: BaseSecretManager
classes.description: An abstract base class for secret management which specifies the required asynchronous and synchronous methods for secret operations, including reading, writing, deleting, and rotating secrets.

methods.name: Optional[str] async_read_secret( self, secret_name: str, optional_params: Optional[dict] = None, timeout: Optional[Union[float, httpx.Timeout]] = None, )
methods.description: Asynchronously reads a secret value given its name and optional parameters.

methods.name: Optional[str] sync_read_secret( self, secret_name: str, optional_params: Optional[dict] = None, timeout: Optional[Union[float, httpx.Timeout]] = None, )
methods.description: Synchronously reads a secret value given its name and optional parameters.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] async_write_secret( self, secret_name: str, secret_value: str, description: Optional[str] = None, optional_params: Optional[dict] = None, timeout: Optional[Union[float, httpx.Timeout]] = None, tags: Optional[Union[dict, list]] = None )
methods.description: Asynchronously writes a secret with specified name, value, and optional metadata.

methods.name: dict async_delete_secret( self, secret_name: str, recovery_window_in_days: Optional[int] = 7, optional_params: Optional[dict] = None, timeout: Optional[Union[float, httpx.Timeout]] = None, )
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a secret by name, with optional recovery window.

methods.name: dict async_rotate_secret( self, current_secret_name: str, new_secret_name: str, new_secret_value: str, optional_params: Optional[dict] = None, timeout: Optional[Union[float, httpx.Timeout]] = None, )
methods.description: Rotates a secret by creating a new secret with a new name and value, then deletes the old secret after verification, handling exceptions accordingly.
